We have template SMARTS: retro_smarts_template: '[C:2]-[OH;D1;+0:1]>>C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si](-C)(-C)-[O;H0;D2;+0:1]-[C:2]'

So retrosynthetic transformation: a carbon attached to OH (alcohol) becomes a silyl ether with t-butyl groups? Actually forward reaction: C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si](-C)(-C)-[O;H0;D2;+0:1]-[C:2]>>[C:2]-[OH;D1;+0:1] (i.e., silyl ether cleavage to alcohol). So applying retrosynthetic template to target molecule will break a Si-O bond? Wait target molecule has no Si. So template likely not applicable. But we need to apply template to target molecule using apply_template. Let's try.
